-----Original Message-----  
From: Oscar Martinez <oscar.martinez@nortritech.com>  
Sent: Thursday, November 7, 2024 4:57 PM  
To: James Burgess  
Subject: Revised Master Agreement  

Har,  

At long last, attached please find the revised agreement, in redline and in final. My instructions were to prepare execution copies, have them signed on behalf of the various Beacon Wind entities, and they are being hand delivered to Mr. Joshua in your credit group for execution on behalf of the various Cedar Point entities. I also prepared guaranty agreements from Beacon Wind Holdings and from Cedar Point Capital., each of which has been either executed or acknowledged on behalf of Beacon Wind. The decision upstairs was that this final version was "take it or leave it" for Cedar Point.  

A summary of the major changes:  

1.   All margining language and references to Collateral were removed.  
2.   All operating subsidiaries were included.  
3.   The "Group" payment concept was eliminated in Section 4 because it was not clear who would actually be making the payment.  

Thanks.  

Oscar  

(See attached file: CP_Mstr_Net_11-8.doc) (See attached file: CP_Mstr_Net_11-8_Final)
